status: proposed source-bound interface; no implementation, simulation or physical qualification

ports.descriptor: d_valid/d_ready, d_base[31:0] LINE ADDRESS not byte address, d_lines[23:0]
ports.operation: start pulse while !busy; rows[clog2(RMAX):0], c[15:0], g[7:0], gs, fmt[1:0]
ports.activation_write: xw_en, xw_addr[clog2(XD)-1:0], xw_grp[6:0], xw_data[2047:0]; NO READY
ports.completion: busy, fault, arrive toggle, release_in matching toggle, released

descriptor_wrapper.width_status: new wrapper widths are explicit proposals, not existing ABI; epoch reuse requires a proven drain, not probabilistic wrap protection
validation: rows in 1..RMAX; c,g nonzero; g*c<=XD, format in {0,1,2}
stream_line_count == rows*g*c checked in widened arithmetic
base+length and region end checked at >=33 bits, no wrap; entire descriptor contained within authorized immutable tensor region
format/layout/K and scale plane identities match source-pinned manifest
output-row range and row mapping bounds checked
all required x fragments written and pipeline visibility satisfied before start
only one op active per SM, no reuse until all weight reads and results retired
g<=2^LEV; use minimumceil(chunks/active_lanes), not artificial power2group count; existing stack completes padded golden tree
descriptor_wrapper.zero_length: reject before SM start; bulk copy accepts zero descriptor but issue sequencer does not define useful zero-row work
descriptor_wrapper.ownership: scheduler owns descriptor publication and completion; ROM service owns accepted request until returned or drained cancellation; SM owns arithmetic state; output collector owns result after rv capture

line_format.payload: bits 1023:0 weight codes, bits 1087:1024 eight E8M0 scale bytes
line_format.FP4: 8 blocks of32 E2M1 nibbles; block j codes at [128*j +:128], scale at [1024+8*j +:8]
line_format.FP8: 4 blocks of32 E4M3 bytes; j<4 codes at [256*j +:256], scale at [1024+8*j +:8]; upper inactive lanes inject zero; use neutral unused exponents
line_format.BF16: 64 BF16 weights packed in low1024bits; exponent plane ignored
line_format.rom_assembly: S82 interleaved physical FP4word:codes0[127:0],scale0[135:128],codes1[263:136],scale1[271:264],zero[273:272]; fourwords regroup code lanes into1024bits and scale bytes into64bitplane. FP8wordcodes[255:0],scale[263:256],zero[273:264]. BF16wordcodes[255:0],zero[273:256].
line_format.order_row_slot: rb,g,t,s; omit s where rb+s>=rows; no line consumed for bubble
line_format.order_group_slot: wave,t,s; wave items are row-major/group-minor; omit slots beyond rows*g
line_format.tail: No runtime keep mask exists. Layout generator must produce exact golden padding at block/chunk/tree boundaries, not merely arbitrary zero extension. Partial output-row slots are omitted. Exact full-K arithmetic proof required for any K padding; preserve E8M0 alignment and exceptional arithmetic.

request_response_contract.accept: req_v && req_ready reserves all four source reads, assembly slot and eventual return slot atomically
request_response_contract.source_tag: {epoch16, sm_id, ring_slot10, subword2}; descriptor ownership held separately per active SM
request_response_contract.scoreboard: 1024 live-slot bits per SM plus identity/epoch state and four completion bits per assembled outstanding line; reject response when not live, duplicate subword, wrong epoch/SM or range
request_response_contract.delivery: at most one1088bit line per SM per cycle; only complete matching four-part payload can assert rsp_v; arbitrary line order allowed because existing SM ring restores stream order
request_response_contract.retire: clear external live slot only upon pulse delivery to SM boundary; SM itself delays ring-slot reuse until consumption
request_response_contract.hold: any valid/ready channel holds complete identity and payload stable during stall
request_response_contract.no_ready_consequence: Once rsp_v is asserted, SM captures unconditionally. Congestion must stop ROM requests using credits; cannot stall pulse or lose payload downstream.
request_response_contract.fault: latch sticky fault and stop new admission; malformed response never forwarded into SM ring

finite_buffers.existing_SM_ring: DEPTH1024 x1088 useful bits =139264B; macro implementation ceil(1088/256)=5 lanes x two512deep groups =10 SRAM macros (163840 physical bytes), plus output queue and boundary pipes
finite_buffers.boundary_channel: CHD=2*PIO+3; with PIO2,7 records each descriptor and request channel
finite_buffers.SM_boundary_pipeline: PIO2 response pipe adds2cycles and1098bits per stage; included source roundtrip model must avoid double count
finite_buffers.source_credit_formula: C_source >= ceil(rate_lines_per_cycle * bounded_reservation_release_latency_cycles)+burst_margin; C_source also >= all in-flight nonstallable reads+queued complete responses. Backpressure may be indefinite; stop admission at C_source occupancy.
finite_buffers.throughput_credit_floor_from_network: conservative2*L_first+2 =30/36/44 slots for64/128/256pairs; justify roundtrip versus actual release point during integration
finite_buffers.source_FIFO_proposal: 128 assembled lines in5 parallel128x256 SRAM macros:139264 useful bits total (17408B) and163840 physical bits total (20480B). Count in addition to existing SM ring unless eliminated by proven handshake equivalence.
finite_buffers.minimum_service_rate: min(1line/cycle, four-bank supply, return arbitration, MAX_OUT/request-to-return latency, actual issue demand)
finite_buffers.result_credit_formula: For arbitrary downstream stalls and unchanged SM with no rv_ready, reserve op_rows records before start. Each record NC*32 + ceil(log2(RMAX)) bits plus external identity/epoch. For NC8/RMAX4096,268bits/record before owner; full4096rows1097728bits useful.
finite_buffers.smaller_result_FIFO: legal only with proven finite downstream stall bound and stop-issue propagation: depth >= max outputs in nonstallable arithmetic pipelines + outputs during credit roundtrip + admitted burst; no such general backpressure exists in current reused SM so whole-op reservation is conservative baseline.
finite_buffers.activation_fragments: XC=(SUB*LBS)*266+(SUB*LSB)*16; FRAGW=NC*XC; beats_per_fragment=ceil(FRAGW/2048). With4,2,16,8 parameters:FRAGW25216bits and13beats. Physical leaf SRAM and write distribution counted separately.

reset_cancellation.reset: coordinated reset of scheduler, service, SM ring and collector clears valids/credits; external fabric must discard old epoch responses before SM restart
reset_cancellation.cancel: stop new descriptors/requests, drain accepted ROM reads into a discard sink while preserving reservations; do not recycle owner/epoch/slot until drain acknowledgment; reset or flush entire SM operation because no cancel input exists
reset_cancellation.output: hold collector valid/data/identity until ready; completion is outputs consumed and requests drained, not busy falling alone
reset_cancellation.epoch_wrap: never reuse epoch until all possible old responses have been acknowledged drained;16bits does not itself prove safety
